passages.text: When Israel departed from Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign tongue, Judah became God’s sanctuary, and Israel His dominion.
passages.sermon:
God led Israel out of Egypt.
God led the house of Jacob away from a people who spoke a foreign language.
God made Judah His holy place.
God made Israel the land He ruled.
passages.original: בְּצֵ֣את יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם בֵּ֥ית יַ֝עֲקֹ֗ב מֵעַ֥ם לֹעֵֽז׃ הָיְתָ֣ה יְהוּדָ֣ה לְקָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל מַמְשְׁלוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back; the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
passages.sermon:
God led Israel out of Egypt.
The sea saw God’s power.
The sea fled.
The Jordan River saw God’s power.
The Jordan River turned back.
The mountains saw God’s power.
The mountains skipped like rams.
The hills saw God’s power.
The hills skipped like lambs.
passages.original: הַיָּ֣ם רָ֭אָה וַיָּנֹ֑ס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן יִסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃ הֶֽ֭הָרִים רָקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־ צֹֽאן׃

passages.text: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back, O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
passages.sermon:
God led Israel out of Egypt.
God showed His power to all creation.
Sea, why did you flee?
Jordan, why did you turn back?
Mountains, why did you skip like rams?
Hills, why did you leap like lambs?
passages.original: מַה־ לְּךָ֣ הַ֭יָּם כִּ֣י תָנ֑וּס הַ֝יַּרְדֵּ֗ן תִּסֹּ֥ב לְאָחֽוֹר׃ הֶֽ֭הָרִים תִּרְקְד֣וּ כְאֵילִ֑ים גְּ֝בָע֗וֹת כִּבְנֵי־ צֹֽאן׃

passages.text: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob, who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
passages.sermon:
The Lord is present.
The God of Jacob is present.
Earth, tremble before Him.
He turned the rock into a pool of water.
He turned hard flint into a flowing spring.
passages.original: מִלִּפְנֵ֣י אָ֭דוֹן ח֣וּלִי אָ֑רֶץ מִ֝לִּפְנֵ֗י אֱל֣וֹהַּ יַעֲקֹֽב׃ הַהֹפְכִ֣י הַצּ֣וּר אֲגַם־ מָ֑יִם חַ֝לָּמִ֗ישׁ לְמַעְיְנוֹ־ מָֽיִם׃
